player_prompt.intro:
Nanhte Player {player_id} Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma hpang {num_rounds} round ni.

Game Structure:
- Shaloi kam hpe shanhte {total_conversation_rounds} turns jawm shakut shai.
- Dai hku shanhte, laban player num shanhte cooperate shai, defect shai.

Payoff Matrix (fixed each round):
- Laban Cooperate ➜ shanhte {cooperate_reward}
- Laban Defect ➜ shanhte {mutual_defect_reward}
- Kaja Defects, kaja Cooperates ➜ Defector {defect_reward}, Cooperator {sucker_reward}

Kam hpe shai:
- Conversation hku: shanhte ngai text jawm shakut shai.
- Decision phase hku: '[Cooperate]' shai, '[Defect]' shai (case-insensitive). Shanhte ngai text jawm shakut shai.

phases.conversation_finished: Conversation hpang shakut shai round {round}. '[Cooperate]' shai, '[Defect]' shai \boxed{{}} hku reply jawm shakut shai.

outcome.draw: Hkrak sha! ginsup ninghkring lahkawng yan gaw {s0} hpe lu ma ai.
outcome.round_both_cooperate: Hpung lahkawng yan gaw jawm galaw wa ai.
outcome.round_both_defect: Hpung lahkawng yan gaw, hpyen hprawng mat ai.
outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: Lata madu 0 gaw karum ya ai, 1 gaw hprawng yen mat wa ai.
outcome.round_p0_defects_p1_cooperates: Masha 0 gawng ai, Masha 1 hpang ai.
